atoms.text: Tim likes to go on hikes at the weekend. Unfortunately, this Saturday there was a thunderstorm, so Tim’s wife said she wouldn’t go for a hike with him. Tim still made it to the top of the mountain, but it wasn’t as fun without his wife by his side.

Choose the sentence that best describes Tim’s mood.

b.sound: Tim felt a bit lonely on the mountain without his wife.
Tim felt happy that his wife stayed at home
